tools.name: list_latest
tools.description: Use when the user wants recent news about AI agents, AGI, robotics or the agent economy from Emerge Times. Returns the newest articles (title, date, URL, category, summary), optionally for one category.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Use when the user asks what Emerge Times has reported on a topic, company or technology. Full-text search over published articles; returns matching articles with summaries. For the full text of one article use get_article.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Use when you need the full text of one Emerge Times article to quote, summarize or cite it. Returns plain text, the source links the article cites, a citation line and the license (CC BY 4.0).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Use to see which topics Emerge Times covers and get category names for list_latest.
